title: Staring app citizen-science project

tellings.quote: I'm just releasing an app at the moment which works on cell phones uh where you can train yourself to get better at it

plain: In 2024 a phone app was put out as a citizen-science project on staring, meant to let ordinary people practise and, he says, get better at it. The scientist Rupert Sheldrake describes it himself on the show, telling Michels he is "just releasing an app at the moment which works on cell phones" so that "you can train yourself to get better at it." If it works as he hopes, anyone could test the skill for themselves.
